To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the work situation of correctional officers has deteriorated since the last survey, in particular in terms of exposure to intimidation.
in 2000, the psychosocial work environment of correctional officers was more stressful and the rates of interpersonal violence at work were higher compared to those of workers in Quebec.
the psychosocial work environment of Quebec correctional officers has improved slightly between 2002 to 2004, but remains very poor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a specific group of workers, correctional officers, and the psychosocial work environment in which they work.
the psychosocial work environment and interpersonal violence at the workplace among correctional officers and their impact on mental health.
the work environment of correctional officers and the effects of this environment on the mental health of officers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the psychosocial work environment in the correctional services in Quebec has not improved between 2002-2004, while the prevalence of intimidation and psychological harassment has increased.
the psychosocial work environment of correctional officers is not conducive to good mental health.
the psychosocial work environment and interpersonal violence at the workplace are still a major problem in the correctional field.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the work environment of correctional officers is a major factor in the development of mental health problems.
the work environment of correctional officers is a source of stress and that it is associated with psychological distress.
correctional officers in Canada and the USA experience a high level of stress and burnout and this has been shown to be associated with poor mental health outcomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

correctional officers are exposed to high psychological and social demands, to poor social support from their superiors and colleagues, to low decision latitude, to a lack of reward at work and, in particular, to intimidation at work.
the correctional work environment in Quebec is a source of significant stress and psychological distress among correction officers.
the psychosocial work environment of correctional officers is a source of mental health problems, particularly among women, and that it has not improved between 2002-2004.
